name: Icha x2 Study Yuno ~Dear Future~
original_name: イチャ×2スタディ 由乃 ~Dear Future~
source:
──A year has passed since you started going out with Mamanoue Yuno. Now both of you are third-year students, in an exciting and romantic summer vacation.

"You really are a pervert, aren't chu......But, I love you♥"

At school, you are as close as ever since childhood, at home, you become very lovey-dovey with each other.

"Doing something embarrassing like this, it absolutely has to stay between us, OK?"

The mischievous Yuno, and a flirting showdown involving Coogle!?
A season of sweet and passionate romance begins once again──.

~Dear Future~

For you and Yuno, and everyone who watches over you, leading to the future, a story of happiness.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.web-marmalade.com/products/icha2/index.html#about-page]official website[/url]]
translation:
──自从和真上由乃交往以来，已经过去一年了。现在你们都是三年级的学生，正在经历一个激动人心又浪漫的暑假。

“你真是个色狼不是吗……但是，我爱你♥”

在学校，你们从小就亲密无间，在家里，你们也变得十分恩爱。

“做出这种丢脸的事，绝对要留在我们之间，好吗？”

淘气的尤诺和库格尔的调情对决！？
甜蜜又热情的浪漫季节再次开始──。

~亲爱的未来~

为你和尤诺，以及所有守护着你的人，通往未来的幸福故事。

[翻译编辑自[url=http://www.web-marmalade.com/products/icha2/index.html#about-page]官网[/url]]
